pages.observation: Natural order. Panel 1 has no people: teal 'SPECIALITY-SPECIFIC TREATMENT PLANNER', then left to right 'Dentist: odontogram', 'Eye doctor: eye markers', 'Paediatrician: growth scales · vaccines'. Panel 2: Ananya 'We'll go through your concerns and decide the right next steps together.', then teal 'PLAN OF CARE: intelligent prescribing · summary · drug interactions · labs · referrals' (lower left), with Ravi silent at right. Issues: (1) Panel 1 breaks the scene. It has no characters, caption or context, and a general clinic seeing a tired adult has no reason to show dentist, eye or paediatric tools. It reads like an advert inserted into the visit. (2) Ananya's reply to 'tired lately' comes only after a page turn and this interruption, so the question-and-answer link is weak. (3) Ravi does not react. (4) In panel 2 the balloon is upper right and the label lower left. The order is probably balloon then label, but a left-to-right reader may glance at the label first. (5) It is unclear whose screen shows PLAN OF CARE. No face is covered.
